title: helianthemum apenninum subsp. stoechadifolium
intro: Helianthemum apenninum subsp. stoechadifolium, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Cistaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been associated with various health benefits such as wound healing, reduction of fever, and relief from digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties.
